description:
Seed one evidence record per archived target in this repository from its recorded archive executions, so re-archiving those targets keeps its coverage and residue identities.

## Background

This repository's event log holds 74 `artifact_archive_executed` records over 50 distinct targets, at most three per target. The released binary reads prior executions only from `.jit/archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, keyed `container/<issue-id>` or `document/<sha256 of the normalized path>`, holding the target and its ordered execution list. There is no migration reader.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A script under `dev/active/f8a6b298-history-independent-reads/` writes one evidence record per archived target, holding that target's executions in log order, and does not modify the event log.
- [hard] REQ-02: The script is idempotent: a second run changes no byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: The number of records equals the number of distinct archived targets, each record's execution count equals that target's event count, an archive preview of a seeded target reports the same coverage as before, and repository validation passes.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: This repository's archived targets get evidence records
